label: Story
text: Last summer we cycled from Munich all the way to Lake Garda. The route over the Alps was exhausting, but the view was really worth it. In the evenings we stayed in small guesthouses along the way.

label: Paragraph
text: When you learn a new language, it is important to practice a little every day. You do not have to sit at your desk for hours. Even ten minutes of speaking in the morning helps a lot. Listen to podcasts, read short articles, and do not be afraid of mistakes, because that is exactly where you learn the most.
